children: First Seacoast announced receipt of final regulatory approval for its merger into Cambridge Financial Group, with closing expected October 1, 2026.
Final regulatory approvals and waivers received on September 24, 2026, completing required regulatory clearances.
Stockholders previously approved the transactions at a Special Meeting on August 27, 2026, enabling closing steps.
Closing is expected October 1, 2026, subject only to satisfaction of customary closing conditions.
